content.short: Hardhat Template provides a Hardhat-based quickstart for developing Solidity smart contracts.
content.description: Hardhat Template, created by Paul Razvan Berg, offers a ready-made Solidity project scaffold with a predefined stack—Ethers.js, Typechain, Solhint, and Solcover. This template allows developers to quickly bootstrap a TypeScript project that includes the bare minimum functions and bindings needed to flesh out and iterate on complex smart contracts, providing a solid starting point for building robust decentralized applications.
